text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL), pyuria, hematuria, nitrites, and leukocyte esterase positivity. The presence of glucose in urine may warrant further evaluation for glycosuria or diabetes. Low urine specific gravity suggests dilute urine. No casts were detected. Clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy are recommended.
